Commentary.Commentary: Right then! England have returned the favor and absolutely dominated this tie. They came back strong to level the series and there is all to play for at Manchester. The action shifts to Old Trafford for the third ODI. That game is all set to begin at 3.30 pm IST (10.00 am GMT) on Sunday, 17th July. But as you know our build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us then. For now, it's goodbye!

Reece Topley is the player of the Match. He says it was a terrific team performance after the last game and he is happy to play his part. Says that it means a lot to come back from a long layoff and prove his ability. Says it is everyone's dream to play for England and says it's a privilege to be a part of this team. Adds that there is a big game on the weekend and hopes they can wrap up the series then.

Jos Buttler the captain of England says that he is delighted with this win and with the response from the team. Adds that it has been a bat-first kind of wicket and chasing has been tough, so they knew they had a chance. States that the partnership between Moeen Ali and David Willey was crucial. Mentions that they needed to take early wickets and put them under pressure early on. On Reece Topley, he says that he bowled brilliantly throughout the series, and getting 6 wickets was special. Says that they have not shown their best, but they are happy to put on a performance like that.

Rohit Sharma, the Indian skipper says, he feels like they bowled really well and the partnership between Moeen Ali and David Willey in the middle overs was good but 246 was easy to chase. Says that if they want to win games they need to take catches and need to improve in that aspect of the game. Still feels it was a good effort to restrict a strong batting lineup to under 250. Admits that he thought the pitch will get better and says it took him by surprise but that said he believes they need to adapt to difficult conditions. Says he is aware that after they lose the early wickets they are short on options and have a long tail. Explains that against top teams they need to play 5 bowlers and 1 all-rounder and it is the responsibility of the top order to do the job. Says the final game will be exciting and it will be a quick turnaround so they need to see what they can do better to win that game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the first innings, the English top order failed and their middle and lower order pushed them to a total of 246 which at that point most believed was not enough. The partnership of 62 runs between David Willey and Moeen Ali turned out to be a crucial one in the end for England. In reply, India failed to find any sort of rhythm on a pitch that seemed to act completely different. The English bowlers got the ball to zip around which helped them to demolish India's batting lineup. There were a few cameo's from Hardik Pandya, Suryakumar Yadav, and Ravindra Jadeja but they eventually perished.

England would be absolutely thrilled with their bowling performance! They outshone their counterparts and would be really proud of their effort. England began the innings on the right foot! They grabbed early wickets and put India under the pump instantly. They made sure they took wickets at regular intervals and kept the pressure on. Reece Topley was the leader of the pack as he ended with figures of 6 wickets for 24 runs and bowled one ball short of his full quota of 10 overs.

India began the chase on the defensive side. They played a couple of overs without scoring any runs before they lost their skipper for a duck. None of the batters seemed to really get in and kept giving away their wickets. Suryakumar Yadav and Hardik Pandya tried to recover the innings but the hope was short-lived. India soon found themselves at 101 for 6. Ravindra Jadeja and Mohammad Shami put on a small partnership but eventually delayed the inevitable for a short while. Overall they will be disappointed to be bowled out for a measly score of 146.

What a bowling performance by England and Reece Topley is the man to take six wickets in this game to get his side over the line. England level the series with a dominating 100-run victory! After a 10-win wicket win in the first ODI, India's batting order collapsed in this game. It's been a complete turnaround since then.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Reece Topley finishes with 6 wickets! What a bowling show from him! A length ball, outside off. Prasidh Krishna looks to have a push at it but he manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Jos Buttler grabs it safely. England win by 100 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, around off. Prasidh Krishna leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Prasidh Krishna tries to leave this one but the ball goes off his bottom edge and falls short of the flip fielder.
Wide! Reece Topley serves a shorter ball, down the leg side. Prasidh Krishna leaves it alone. Wide called!

OUT! TIMBER! Reece Topley gets a five-wicket haul! What a performance! This one is on a good length and pitching on leg, Yuzvendra Chahal tries to play at it and gets beaten on the outside edge. The ball goes on to hit the off pole and India is now 9 down!
Full delivery served on off, Yuzvendra Chahal fends this towards cover.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Jasprit Bumrah tries to flick this one but he gets a leading edge towards point.
Outside off, fuller ball. Yuzvendra Chahal pushes it towards point for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Yuzvendra Chahal flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Very full this time, outside off. Yuzvendra Chahal fails to dig this one out.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Yuzvendra Chahal tucks it towards mid on. The fielder fumbles there and the batters pick up two runs!
A leg-break, very full, outside off. Jasprit Bumrah pushes it towards cover for a single.
Reece Topley serves a full toss once again in line with the stumps. Missing his yorkers here. Yuzvendra Chahal guides it towards mid-wicket.
Full toss this time outside off, Yuzvendra Chahal knocks this towards covers.
Reece Topley goes 'round the wicket and angles it in from outside off,  Jasprit Bumrah clips this to deep square leg for a single.
Reece Topley serves this full and gets the ball to angle away from the batter. Jasprit Bumrah feels for it and misses.
Bowls a yorker this time in line with the stumps. Jasprit Bumrah digs this out back to the bowler.
Reece Topley serves this full outside off, Jasprit Bumrah looks to work this offside and misses.
Shorter one, outside off. Yuzvendra Chahal hangs back and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller one, much straighter now, around middle. Yuzvendra Chahal pushes it back to the bowler.
Beaten now! A leg break from Liam Livingstone now, outside off. Yuzvendra Chahal gets beaten while trying to defend this one.
Pitches it up again, on middle. Yuzvendra Chahal blocks it out.
A fuller one, wide of off. Yuzvendra Chahal leans to drive this one but he misses.
Yuzvendra Chahal walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! India lose their last recognized batter! This should be the game for England! Liam Livingstone is brought into the attack and gets a wicket from his very first delivery! Liam Livingstone flights this full and turning in from off, Ravindra Jadeja looks to cut this and is cramped for space. Misses his cut and the ball shatters into the stumps. 8 wickets down now and India are most definitely out of this contest!
Jasprit Bumrah comes out to bat and India will be hoping he can support Ravindra Jadeja. Also, Liam Livingstone comes into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! England have finally managed to break this partnership! Reece Topley is the one who sends back Mohammad Shami! He grabs his fourth wicket of the game. A low full toss, slower one. Mohammad Shami looks to go big and over mid on. But the ball goes off the top edge and lobs up in the air. Ben Stokes at mid off runs forward and takes a good catch. India lose their 7th wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Stokes b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Another fuller ball, around off. Ravindra Jadeja pushes it towards cover for a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Ravindra Jadeja pushes it towards mid off.

A length ball, around middle and off. Mohammad Shami swings his bat at it but the ball goes off his top edge towards third man. Brydon Carse runs for the ball, he slips on his way but he does well to stop the ball. Single taken!
Good change of pace from Reece Topley! A shorter one, slower in pace, around middle. Mohammad Shami looks to pull this but he gets undone by the lack of pace.
Fuller one, around middle. Mohammad Shami drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Reece Topley (7-2-20-3) is back on!
This one is full as well, aimed for the pads, Ravindra Jadeja flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Brydon Carse serves this a fraction full outside off. Ravindra Jadeja taps to down to the right of the bowler.
Brydon Carse angles this into the pads from off on a good length. Mohammad Shami clips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Brydon Carse bowls a slower yorker on off, Mohammad Shami brings his bat downs and keeps the ball out.
Brydon Carse serves this one short and outside off, Mohammad Shami sways out of the way.
Back of a length to begin with outside off, Ravindra Jadeja taps this past the point fielder to deep backward point for a single.

DRINKS! The story remains the same so far. England continues to dominate the game, while India are in a need of a big partnership. Ravindra Jadeja has done well thus far, he has rotated the strike well. Mohammad Shami too has looked good, he has been a bit aggressive. The duo has put together 35 runs till now. India still needs 111 more off 102 balls with only 4 wickets in hand.

David Willey bowls this on a length outside off, Mohammad Shami pulls this towards the cow corner fence. The ball goes really high in the air but does not have the distance on it. However, it lands safely as two fielders converge on it. The batters take two runs in the meantime.
Back of a length and outside off, Ravindra Jadeja works this towards deep backward point and is happy to play the anchor role. Takes a single and gets Mohammad Shami on strike.
David Willey pulls his length back and bowls this outside off. Ravindra Jadeja happy to leave this one alone.
David Willey bowls this on a good length on off, Mohammad Shami flicks this towards mid on and rushes across for a single.
This is full outside off and Mohammad Shami goes back to swinging. Mises the ball this time as the ball stays a touch low.
David Willey serves this on a good length outside off. Some extra bounce as Ravindra Jadeja negotiates it well and works it towards deep backward point for a single.
DROPPED! Another length ball, around middle. Mohammad Shami pushes it uppishly off the back foot back to the bowler. Brydon Carse gets his hands to the ball but he spills it out.
A length delivery, around middle and off. Mohammad Shami backs away and blocks it out.
Shorter one, around middle. Mohammad Shami pulls it towards square leg.
Fuller now, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja drives it towards cover for a run.
On a length, around middle. Mohammad Shami tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

A mix-up..but no harm done! An overthrow for India! A length ball, around outside off. Ravindra Jadeja pushes it towards cover. He leaves his crease, Mohammad Shami sets off for a run as well. But he is sent back mid-way. Joe Root collects the ball and throws it at the wrong end, towards the striker. He misses the stumps and the batters eventually sneak in a single.
Angles this into the pads from a good length. Ravindra Jadeja tucks this towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Full this time outside off, Mohammad Shami mistimes his shot towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
On a good length once again outside off, Ravindra Jadeja guides this to deep backward point for a single.
David Willey bowls this on a good length outside off, Ravindra Jadeja is watchful as he leaves this one alone.
David Willey goes short to Mohammad Shami outside off. He pulls this in the air in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on. Does not time it well and gets just a single.
David Willey begins with a good length delivery just outside off, Ravindra Jadeja guides this wide of third man for a single.
David Willey (7-2-17-1) comes back into the attack.
SIX! KABOOM! Wow, what a shot from Mohammad Shami! A fuller ball, around off. Mohammad Shami shimmies down the pitch and tonks it high over long off for a biggie!
Loopy ball, full, and around middle and off. Ravindra Jadeja lunges forward and pushes it towards cover for a quick single.
Pitches it up, darting it on the pads. Ravindra Jadeja uses the depth of the crease and flicks it towards fine leg. Two taken!
Back of a length again, spinning into the right-hander. Mohammad Shami hangs back and tucks it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja uses the depth of his crease and pushes it towards point for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middlle. Ravindra Jadeja leans and pushes it towards mid on.
Craig Overton serves this on a good length outside off, Mohammad Shami looks to swing his bat and misses.

FOUR! A streaky boundary from Mohammad Shami! Craig Overton bangs it in short and outside off, Mohammad Shami goes for a pull and top edges it high towards fine leg. Falls just before the boundary as India collect four valuable runs!
This is a fraction full outside off. Mohammad Shami works this towards cover-point and looks for a single. Ravindra Jadeja sends him back.
Craig Overton angles this one in from outside off on a good length. Mohammad Shami looks to work this leg side and misses. Hits his thigh pads and goes over the slip for a couple of leg byes.
This one is on a good length outside off, Mohammad Shami punches this towards cover with no foot movement.
Craig Overton serves this on a good length outside off, Ravindra Jadeja guides it to deep backward point for a single.
Another short ball, spinning in, around middle. Mohammad Shami stays back and looks to flick but he gets a slight inside edge back onto the pads.
Outside off, a shorter one. Mohammad Shami knocks it towards mid on.
Pulls his length ball, around middle. Mohammad Shami taps it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Mohammad Shami gets off the mark with a boundary! A fuller one, outside off. Mohammad Shami drives it powerfully through cover for a boundary.
Shorter one, spinning in, around middle. Mohammad Shami blocks it out.
Mohammad Shami walks out to the middle with India in big trouble.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Hardik Pandya tries to go big but he holes out. Moeen Ali the man who gets rid of him. Touch short, around off. Hardik Pandya stays in his crease and pulls this one. The ball goes off the top edge and towards deep mid-wicket. Liam Livingstone runs to his right a bit and takes a good low catch. India are now 6 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly back of a length and in line with the stumps. Ravindra Jadeja fends this back to the bowler. Just 2 runs of the over!
Goes fuller this time outside off, Hardik Pandya works this through backward point for a single.
Craig Overton pulls his length back a bit and serves this outside off, Hardik Pandya looks to pull this but mistimes it down the pitch.
Full and on the pads, Ravindra Jadeja clips this to deep square leg for a single. 100 up for India!
Short and angling away from the left-hander. Ravindra Jadeja leaves this one alone.
Craig Overton serves this on a good length outside off. Ravindra Jadeja fends this towards covers.
Full again, outside off. Hardik Pandya advances down the pitch and blocks it out.
Tad shorter, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja taps it towards point. A single is taken!
SIX! Bang! Poor delivery and punished! Moeen Ali serves this short, around middle. Ravindra Jadeja uses the depth of his crease and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Tosses it up, full and around off. Hardik Pandya knocks it down to long on for a single.
Full again, flatter one, around off. Hardik Pandya steps down the pitch and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker, fuller, around middle and off. Hardik Pandya pushes it towards cover.
This one is on a good length outside off, Ravindra Jadeja is tempted into the shot and gets beaten on the outside edge.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Ravindra Jadeja! Craig Overton bangs this one into the pitch and angles it into the batter. Ravindra Jadeja ducks and the ball hit his helmet and then the bat and flies over the keeper for a boundary! This could ahve gone anywhere as Ravindra Jadeja gets away with one.
Craig Overton goes short outside off, Hardik Pandya guides this to third man for a single.
Short this time outside off, Ravindra Jadeja slashes this towards deep backward point for a single.
Full once again in line with the stumps, Ravindra Jadeja punches this down the ground and looks for a single. Hardik Pandya refuses the run as mid off cuts it out.
Craig Overton begins with a full-length delivery in line with the stumps, Hardik Pandya flicks this towards square leg for a single.
Change of ends for Craig Overton (4-0-8-0) as he is brought back into the attack.
Shortish ball, around middle and leg. Hardik Pandya flicks it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. There was a throw at the bowler's end but Hardik Pandya was well in.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Loopy ball, full and on middle. Hardik Pandya shimmies down the pitch and drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
This one lands around middle and straightens after pitching. Hardik Pandya looks to flick but he gets a leading edge towards cover.
Shorter now, darting it on the thigh pads. Ravindra Jadeja works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Ravindra Jadeja drives it back to the bowler.
Moeen Ali begins with a fuller one, outside off. Hardik Pandya leans to drive but the ball goes off his inner half towards long on for a single.
Time for some spin now. Moeen Ali has been brought into the attack.
Swing and a miss! Shorter ball, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja stays in his crease and tries to slash this away but he misses.
A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Ravindra Jadeja tucks it towards mid-wicket. He wanted a single there but he is sent back!
Fuller now, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja drives it to the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja dabs it towards point.
A length ball, outside off. Hardik Pandya pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Reece Topley comes 'round the wicket and serves a fuller ball, outside off. Hardik Pandya drives and finds the fielder at cover.
A length ball, outside off, swinging away. Ravindra Jadeja lets that go through to the keeper.
Craig Overton drops it short, around middle. Ravindra Jadeja looks to pull this one but he misses and gets hit on his shoulder.
Outside off, fuller ball. Ravindra Jadeja drives it to the fielder at cover-point.
Another short ball, outside off again, swinging away. Ravindra Jadeja hangs back and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length, shaping away, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja leaves it alone.
Fuller now, around middle. Hardik Pandya drives it gently straight down the ground. Only a single.
Another length ball, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja offers no shot once again!
Wide of off, on a length. Ravindra Jadeja leaves it alone.
Fuller on, around middle and leg. Hardik Pandya flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Ravindra Jadeja tucks it towards fine leg and gets off the mark with a single.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Reece Topley comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! He gets rid of the in-form batter, Suryakumar Yadav! A big wicket this for England! Tad shorter this time, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav stays in his crease and tries to push this away on the off side, but the ball goes off his inside edge and back onto the stumps. Suryakumar Yadav departs after a positive start. India are now 5 down!
A length ball from over the wicket, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav taps it towards point.
Reece Topley is back on!
This one is short and outside off, Hardik Pandya looks to pull this and mistimes it as the ball rolls towards mid-wicket.
Full and angling into the pads, Suryakumar Yadav clips this towards fine leg and gets a run.

Craig Overton serves this full outside off, Hardik Pandya hits this hard to the right of the cover fielder who manages to get a palm on it and guide it towards mid off. They get a single in the process.
Craig Overton goes short and this is aimed at the batter. Hardik Pandya looks to pull and misses. A shade too high but the square leg umpire says that this one is fine.
Full and staying onto the pads, Suryakumar Yadav flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
A fraction short and angling into the pads, Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick this leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
Full outside off, Hardik Pandya works his wrist and knocks it towards mid on
Brydon Carse goes full outside off, Suryakumar Yadav works this to deep cover-point for a single.
On a length and angling into the pads, Suryakumar Yadav clips this towards deep square leg for a brace.

SIX! That is a Suryakumar Yadav special shot as he pulls this over fine leg for a biggie! Brydon Carse bangs this in short and angling into the body. Suryakumar Yadav swivels and lofts it high and handsome over the fence for a maximum! He looks like he is batting on a different pitch!
Goes full this time outside off, Suryakumar Yadav knocks this firmly towards mid off.
Brydon Carse serves this short outside off, Hardik Pandya cuts this towards third man for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav drives this firmly but straight to the fielder at cover.
Pulls his length back a tad, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Fuller now, around middle. Hardik Pandya flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Extra bounce there! A length ball, around middle, that takes off after landing. Hardik Pandya tries to block this but the ball hits the higher part of the bat after the bounce.
On a length, around middle and off. Hardik Pandya blocks it out watchfully.
Swing and a miss! Tad shorter, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav hangs back and looks to slash this away but he misses.

There is a review from England here! Brydon Carse serves this back of a length and angling into the pads, Suryakumar Yadav looks to work this leg side and misses the ball. Gets hit high on the pads and there is a massive appeal from the English players. The umpire says it is not out but Jos Buttler disagrees and decides to review. The bat is really far from the ball and the third umpire does not need UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows two reds and one green as the ball is going over the stumps. England lose their review. Their decision-making has been poor this game.
Brydon Carse pulls his length back and gets the ball to rise up sharply. On an off stump line and Hardik Pandya gloves this to fine leg for a single.
Brydon Carse serves this on a good length outside off, Hardik Pandya slashes at it and finds the point fielder.
This one is on a good length outside off. Hardik Pandya strokes it straight to mid off.
Brydon Carse begins with a short delivery angled into the batter. Suryakumar Yadav pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.

DRINKS! England are currently top of proceedings here! They have demolished India's top order. The ball has been nipping around for England and they have been rewarded for it. For India, Hardik Pandya and Suryakumar Yadav have doing some repair work for India. They have looked good so far, and they will want to stick around for much longer.
Craig Overton goes full outside off, Suryakumar Yadav works this elegantly past the point fielder for a single.

Craig Overton serves this back of a length and angled into the body. Hardik Pandya pulls and mistimes it wide of mid on and rushes across for a single. David Willey collects and throws at the non-striker's end. A direct hit and Hardik Pandya would have been a goner!
Full delivery in line with the stumps, Hardik Pandya defends this back to the bowler.
Craig Overton pulls his length back and serves this outside off, Hardik Pandya dabs it towards point.
Fuller this time outside off, Suryakumar Yadav knocks this towards deep cover for a single.
Craig Overton serves this on a good length outside off, Suryakumar Yadav guides this towards backward point.
FOUR! Top shot! A half-volley this time, around middle and off. Hardik Pandya shows the full face of the bat and drives it down the ground, past the diving fielder at mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav punches it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Hardik Pandya tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav stays in his crease and guides it towards third man for a single.
Lovely shot! Not in the gap though! Shorter, around off. Hardik Pandya punches it off the back foot towards deep point for a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Hardik Pandya dabs it off the back foot towards mid off.
Tad fuller now, around middle and leg. Hardik Pandya clips it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Hardik Pandya pushes it off the back foot towards point.
Oh! A lovely delivery! A length delivery, outside off, a bit of extra bounce there. Hardik Pandya stays in his crease and tries to block this but he gets undone by that extra bounce.
On a length, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Nicely done! Another length ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav rocks back opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a brace.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Suryakumar Yadav flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Outside off, a length ball. Suryakumar Yadav guides it down to third man for a single. He retains the strike!
Lovely shot! Brydon Carse pitches it up, outside off. Hardik Pandya drives it firmly through cover. The ball will not race away to the boundary. But the batters get three runs.
Make that four! This is a tad bit shorter, outside off. Hardik Pandya hops and dabs it towards point.
This one is angling in, on a good length, around middle and leg. Hardik Pandya tucks it towards mid-wicket. Three dots in a row!
Fuller now, outside off. Hardik Pandya drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
A peach! On a length now, outside off. Hardik Pandya stays in his crease and tries to defend this but he misses. The ball misses his outside edge by a whisker!
David Willey is a touch too full angling into the pads, Suryakumar Yadav flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! This is a shot of a man in form! Full once again on off, Suryakumar Yadav knocks this straight past mid off for a beautiful boundary! India will be hoping Suryakumar Yadav plays a blinder here!
Full and angled in from middle, Suryakumar Yadav hits this back to the right of the bowler.
Good-length delivery first up to Hardik Pandya outside off. He plays it with soft hands towards cover for a quick single.
Hardik Pandya is the new man in and he will have to play a big innings here to take India home.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! England are bossing the game so far! India are in all sorts of trouble here! A horrid start for the visitors. David Willey now gets rid of Virat Kohli! A huge wicket! This was on a length, shaping away and wide of off. Virat Kohli leans forward, and tries to have a poke at it but he manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Jos Buttler takes an easy catch. India are now 4 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: David Willey begins with a good length delivery in line with the stumps. Virat Kohli goes to defend but misses and gets hit on the groin.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Suryakumar Yadav tucks it towards square leg off the back foot. End of a successful first over from Brydon Carse!
Fuller this time, around off. Virat Kohli drives it towards mid off. Ben Stokes dives to his right and makes yet another good stop! Only a single! England have been terrific in the field.
Another length delivery, outside off. Virat Kohli taps it towards point.
Off the mark straightaway! On a length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Suryakumar Yadav walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rishabh Pant's stay at the wicket is short! Brydon Carse bowls a full toss in line with the stumps, Rishabh Pant goes to hit this but there is no timing. Loops it straight to the mid one fielder. Philip Salt (sub) goes forward and takes an easy catch. India have lost three now and England are right on top!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Philip Salt b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: Full delivery angled in from outside off, Virat Kohli looks to play this offside and gets an inside edge towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, England are allowed to place 4 fielders outside the inner circle till the 40th over! Aso, Brydon Carse comes into the attack.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Rishabh Pant mistimes this towards cover-point.
David Willey continues to bowl on a good length this time outside off, Rishabh Pant leaves  this one alone as well.
David Willey gets this one to nip back in from a good length, Rishabh Pant leaves this alone and the ball goes just over the stumps. This is either poor judgment or an outstanding leave!
Angling away from the right-hander from a good length. Virat Kohli works this through backward point for a single.
David Willey serves this on a good length just outside off, Virat Kohli defends this one solidly.
Beauty! A length ball, outside off, shaping away a tad. Virat Kohli presses forward to block this one but he misses as the ball zips past his outside edge.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rishabh Pant leans forward and blocks it out towards cover.
Rishabh Pant walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shikhar Dhawan's labored innings comes to an end! Reece Topley has bowled much better deliveries in this over. This was though a loose one, it was going down leg but he gets the wicket! This is bowled on a good length and angling down leg, Shikhar Dhawan comes across and tries to work this fine but gets a faint edge to the keeper. Jos Buttler takes an easy catch and Reece Topley celebrates and laughs at Shikhar Dhawan as he finally has his man! India in trouble here. They need to build a partnership!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten once again! Good-length delivery outside off, straightens off the wicket. Shikhar Dhawan pushes at it and misses his outside edge.
Pulls the length back now and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan taps it back down the pitch.
FOUR! A good ball followed by a boundary! Full delivery angled into the pads, Shikhar Dhawan flicks this through mid-wicket for a boundary! Shikhar Dhawan gets his first boundary!
What a delivery! On a good length and pitching on middle. Shikhar Dhawan plays for the line and gets beaten as the ball straightens and goes over the stumps through to the keeper.
Full once again outside off, Shikhar Dhawan knocks this past mid off but gets only a run as mid on comes across to stop the ball.
This one is a fraction full in line with the stumps. Shikhar Dhawan fends it back to the bowler.
On a good length outside off, Virat Kohli guides this towards deep backward point for a single.
On a length outside off, Shikhar Dhawan gets down the pitch and flicks this through square leg for a single.
David Willey goes full and angles it into the pads, Shikhar Dhawan tries to flick and misses the line of the delivery. Gets hit on the pads once again.
David Willey gets this one to nip back in from outside off on a good length. Shikhar Dhawan comes across to defend this and gets hit on the pads.
On a length, around off. Virat Kohli stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Full and outside off. Virat Kohli drives it towards mid off. He wanted a single there but he decides against it in the end.
Outside off once again and full, Virat Kohli is happy to defend this towards cover-point.
Pulls his length back a bit outside off, Virat Kohli fends this towards cover.

FOUR! Make that two in a row! Reece Topley goes full once again, this time outside off. Virat Kohli takes a long stride forward and places it to the left of the diving mid off fielder for another boundary!
FOUR! Second boundary for Virat Kohli! Reece Topley goes full on middle, Virat Kohli hits this straight back past the bowler and gets a boundary to straight long on.
David Willey goes full this time on middle, Shikhar Dhawan knocks this towards mid on.
David Willey angles this one down leg as well from a good length. Shikhar Dhawan clips this towards fine leg and gets a couple of runs.
Angling this one into the pads from a good length, Shikhar Dhawan knocks this towards short mid-wicket.
David Willey delivers this one a good length once again outside off, Shikhar Dhawan shimmies down the wicket and knocks it towards the cover fielder.
On a good length once again and a touch wider outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leaves this one alone.
David Willey serves this on a good length just outside off. Shikhar Dhawan fends this back to the bowler.
Outside off, a length ball, shaping away. Virat Kohli leaves it alone.
FOUR! Virat Kohli gets off the mark with a lovely shot! Full again, around off. Virat Kohli lunges forward and drives it down the ground for a boundary.
On a length, on the thigh pads, a but of extra bounce there as well! Virat Kohli looks to flick this away but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pads.
Full, around middle and off. Shikhar Dhawan drives it towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. He gets off the mark!
A length ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan taps it towards point.

No run. This is excellent fielding from England! They are keeping the pressure on! Full and outside off. Shikhar Dhawan drives it crisply towards mid off. Ben Stokes dives to his right and makes a good stop!
Pitches it up again, around middle and off. Virat Kohli drives it down towards mid off. Back-to-back maidens from David Willey!
Pulls his length back a tad, outside off. Virat Kohli opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
Full again, on middle. Virat Kohli knocks it towards mid on.
Fuller ball, outside off. Virat Kohli drives it firmly towards cover. The fielder there makes an excellent stop!
A length delivery, outside off. Virat Kohli leaves it alone.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Virat Kohli stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses.
On a length now, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan looks to defend this one but he gets beaten on the outside edge. A successful over from Reece Topley!
Straying down leg from a good length. There is some movement off the wicket. Virat Kohli works this off his pads towards backward sqaure leg for a single.

OUT! LBW! An early breakthrough for England! A perfect start from them! They have sent the dangerous, Rohit Sharma packing for a duck. A length ball, this one nips back in a tad, around middle. Rohit Sharma looks to flick this one but he misses and gets and gets struck on his pad. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Rohit Sharma though opts for a review. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Rohit Sharma has to walk back! Virat Kohli replaces him.
Good-length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma looks to lift this one straight and misses.
FOUR LEG BYES! Angling down leg from a good length. Rohit Sharma looks to glance this and misses, hit his thigh pad, and runs away to the fine leg boundary for leg bye.
Full delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma looks to loft this leg side but only manages an inside edge onto his pads.
Full delivery angling down leg, Shikhar Dhawan plays over this and gets hit on his pads. There is a big appeal and the umpires remains unmoved. They do not review and replays show an inside edge.
Angles this into the pad on a good length. Shikhar Dhawan works this towards mid-wicket.
Full around off, Shikhar Dhawan defends this back to the bowler.
This one is a fraction short outside off, Shikhar Dhawan knocks this back to the bowler.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Shikhar Dhawan fends this awkwardly off his gloves.
David Willey begins with a fuller one, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leans and blocks it out watchfully.
David Willey will bowl from the other end.
Another length delivery, around middle and off. Rohit Sharma defends it out. A positive start from England! A maiden to begin with!
On a length, around middle. Rohit Sharma blocks it out.

Lovely fielding! A shorter one, outside off. Rohit Sharma pushes it off the back foot towards cover. Liam Livingstone dives to his right and makes a terrific stop there! Shikhar Dhawan was sent back after leaving his crease, but the throw from Liam Livingstone was well away.
Outside off, shaping away a tad, a length ball. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone.
On the pads now, angling in, a length ball. Rohit Sharma flicks it towards square leg.
Reece Topley begins with a full ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point.
